name: Unity USD
oneLiner: UUSD is Anything Labs's BSC-based protocol dollar minted against managed stablecoin and crypto collateral, with limited public mechanism documentation.
collateral: Undisclosed; Anything Labs markets UUSD as reserve-backed but publishes no collateral composition, reserve assets, or attestation in the whitepaper, site, or repo
pegMechanism: Undisclosed; the whitepaper and docs describe no peg-maintenance mechanism. On-chain, UUSD is an upgradeable Ownable proxy ERC-20 on BSC with owner-controlled (4/6 Safe) mint and burn

sources.label: PublicNode BSC RPC used for current-live verification

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At a current-live BSC PublicNode read on 2026-07-15 (head 110070558), tracked UUSD proxy 0x61a10e8556bed032ea176330e7f17d6a12a10000 had EIP-1967 implementation 0xA4f44c290CC693fC0c985d679281c61e99d9Be9a and proxy-admin slot 0x61108af7de820cAce912F6AEf863c19d1Dc2b7FE. The verified implementation exposes freeze/unfreeze and pause/unpause to admin or owner; its _update path rejects frozen senders and recipients and all updates while paused, transferFrom separately rejects a frozen spender, and approvals reject frozen owners or spenders. The live proxy reported owner=4/6 Safe 0x009c5467667dcD2Ab8C310E84B105cC0b570a8F4, admin=zero, paused=false, and frozen(random)=false. Safe-origin eth_call simulations of freeze(random) and pause() both succeeded without broadcast; an unprivileged random-account zero-value transfer returned true. The free BSC endpoint rejects archival calls without a personal token, so this is a current-live observation rather than a retained fixed-block claim. The proxy-admin chain is 0x61108af7de820cAce912F6AEf863c19d1Dc2b7FE -> owner 0x2D49CB4194dFa42d711699a87C10C6BbC05d94b6 -> the same Safe, so it also retains an upgrade path, although the live direct freeze/pause functions already resolve this as Yes. UUSD's official issuance page and repository describe the same controls, and the March 2026 SlowMist report identifies arbitrary account freeze and global pause; its then-reported 3/5 Safe configuration is treated as historical because the current live read is 4/6. The current UUSD pages did not link Terms, Privacy, or a reserve-attestation page, and Arquivo.pt returned no UUSD site snapshot; neither the whitepaper nor the contract audit supplies a proof of reserves. Those legal/transparency gaps are not used to infer the direct on-chain result.

reserves.name: Protocol-managed stablecoin and crypto collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Anything Labs and undisclosed protocol collateral counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: The reviewed UUSD website, whitepaper, and repository do not disclose reserve assets, category weights, named counterparties, or an assurance report. The existing 100% aggregate envelope is retained as an explicit evidence gap rather than decomposed into fabricated stablecoin or crypto slices.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: UUSD official disclosures and repository review
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The entire reserve envelope is unclassified beyond the protocol's reserve-backed marketing claim; no current composition, custody, or assurance evidence was found.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The official disclosures do not identify the reserve assets or provide a current auditable composition.

providers.name: Anything Labs and UUSD protocol contracts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed public materials do not identify reserve custodians, account segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms.

mintAuthority.summary: Unity USD (UUSD) is an upgradeable Ownable proxy ERC-20 on BSC operated by Anything Labs; live reads resolve the token owner to a 4/6 Safe that can mint/burn directly and controls the proxy-admin ownership chain.

controls.label: UUSD owner Safe
controls.evidence: BSC owner() returned this Safe at block 103627514. RPC getOwners() decoded 6 owners (matching stored list); storage slot 4 returned threshold 4. No enabled modules; zero guard confirmed. The owner can mint/burn directly under the UUSD implementation.

controls.label: UUSD proxy-admin ownership chain
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot returned this contract; owner() returned 0x2D49CB4194dFa42d711699a87C10C6BbC05d94b6 (reconfirmed at BSC block 103627514), whose owner() resolves to the same 4/6 Safe (0x009c5467667dcD2Ab8C310E84B105cC0b570a8F4). ProxyAdmin is a non-multisig upgrader contract; modules not applicable.

review.evidence: BSC block 103627514: token owner() = 0x009c5467667dcD2Ab8C310E84B105cC0b570a8F4 (4/6 Safe, 6 owners confirmed via RPC getOwners, threshold 4 via storage slot 4); proxy-admin chain confirmed (EIP-1967 slot → 0x61108af7…, owner → 0x2D49CB4…, owner → same Safe). All mint-capable surfaces on-chain confirmed. Reserve backing is undisclosed by issuer but does not affect mint-path verification.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: UUSD presents an issuer-controlled reserve-backed design even though the reserve composition and peg operations remain insufficiently disclosed.
